name: Wooden door (grey-box prefab)
notes: The slice's spawn-room door (docs/design/vertical-slice.md B2, mw-e03.18): a hinged plank door filling the grey-box doorway's 1.2 × 2.2 m opening, 6 cm thick. One second to swing fully open, about how long a hand-pushed door takes. Seasoned wood, so it burns (a torch or the brazier can open a second route) and breaks under heavy blows when a scene makes it breakable. Shuts out light, smoke and most sound while closed. A creaky 50 dB when it starts to move: a stealthy player hears it, and so do guards nearby (mw-e09).
